Chloe —

Appreciate the tracker. A few quick clarifications from Cliniva Legal / Engineering:

1) Signers: Legal (Emma Roe) + Procurement (procure@cliniva.com). Procurement asked that DocuSign be pre-populated with PO reference field.

2) Onshore processing: we have a small subset (pilot telemetry for the UK clinical study) that must remain within UK/EU. We need to confirm whether Redwood’s onshore cache fallback will be auditable for those sessions and whether the TIA/DTIA scope will include cache logs.

3) Subprocessors: we’ll upload the current vendor CSV today (attached Cliniva_requirements_summary.pdf includes the expected fields). We also have a higher-assurance requirement for any subprocessor that has access to raw transcripts — they must provide an attestation.

We’re generally aligned on the timeline but prefer a 2026-10-06 mapping call (Wednesday) at 10:00 BST if that works for your team.

James / Emma —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the file. Quick legal & controls clarifications from our side (I’ve attached a focused redline for the UK Addendum as well — UK_Addendum_redline.pdf):

- Auditable onshore fallback: Redwood’s onshore cache events are retained for 90 days by default and include session hashing + routing logs. We can include TIA evidence showing cache hit/miss and egress endpoints for the telemetry subset. If Cliniva needs longer retention for auditability, we can discuss a scoped exception.

- Subprocessor attestations: we can provide a CSV of subprocessors plus signed attestations for those with access to unredacted transcripts. Timeline: we can deliver the CSV within 48 hours and attestations within two weeks for high-assurance vendors.

- PO field in DocuSign: no problem — Marissa (cc’d) will ensure the envelope has a PO field and instructions for procurement.

Open legal items we’ll bring to the call: the delegation clause for transient processors, and the carveout language for customer-requested onshore processing. I recommend the 2026-10-06 call proposed by James; Chloe/Laura please confirm availability.

Attachments: UK_Addendum_redline.pdf (redline comments inline).
